proposals.title: Proposal 7 — Stockholder Proposal Requesting, on an Advisory Basis, Action to Allow Stockholders to Request Special Meetings of Stockholders
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie and Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board amend bylaws to give holders of 15% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors Recommends a Vote AGAINST Proposal 7.
